name: What are the most popular upgrades for tiny homes in the San Diego area?

mainEntity.name: What are the most popular upgrades for tiny homes in the San Diego area?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the San Diego area, popular tiny home upgrades often focus on maximizing comfort and efficiency in the local climate. This includes enhanced insulation for temperature regulation, efficient HVAC systems like mini-split units, and durable, weather-resistant exterior finishes. Many clients also opt for expanded outdoor living spaces, such as fold-down decks or large windows to enjoy the coastal views and climate. Smart home features for energy management and security are also highly sought after by local homeowners.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popular upgrades in San Diego include enhanced insulation, efficient HVAC, durable exteriors, expanded outdoor living spaces, and smart home features.
